title: TabK: Amortized Bayesian Estimation of the Number of Clusters in Tabular Data
abstract: arXiv:2611.28335v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Estimating the number of clusters, $k$, is a fundamental prerequisite for most clustering algorithms. Traditionally, this estimation has relied on computationally expensive grid searches over internal cluster validity indices (CVIs) or adaptive clustering algorithms, both constrained by specific statistical assumptions. We introduce TabK, a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer architecture that frames the estimation of $k$ as an amortized Bayesian inference problem for tabular data. TabK leverages a novel Quantile Feature Encoder (QFE) to extract position-free, content-derived representations from empirical marginal distributions. By learning a generalized structural bias over a diverse synthetic prior, TabK estimates the number of clusters in a single forward pass per ensemble member. Evaluated across 50 diverse real-world benchmarks, TabK outperforms all competing methods, achieving a mean absolute error (MAE) value of 1.04 com

translated_title: TabK：表格数据中聚类数量的摊销贝叶斯估计
translated_abstract: 估计聚类数量 $k$ 是大多数聚类算法的基本前提。传统上，这种估计依赖于计算成本高昂的内部聚类有效性指标网格搜索或自适应聚类算法，而这两者都受到特定统计假设的约束。我们提出了 TabK，这是一种零样本、置换不变的 transformer 架构，它将表格数据中 $k$ 的估计问题框架化为摊销贝叶斯推断问题。TabK 利用一种新颖的分位数特征编码器（QFE）从经验边际分布中提取无位置性、基于内容的表示。通过在多样化的合成先验上学习一种广义的结构偏差，TabK 能够在每个集成成员的单次前向传播中估计出聚类数量。在 50 个多样化的真实世界基准测试中，TabK 的表现优于所有竞争方法，取得了 1.04 的平均绝对误差（MAE）。
tldr: TabK 是一种零样本、置换不变的 transformer 架构，通过新颖的分位数特征编码器和摊销贝叶斯推断，在单次前向传播中即可估计表格数据的聚类数量，并在 50 个真实世界基准上优于所有现有方法。
en_tdlr: TabK is a zero-shot, permutation-invariant transformer that frames cluster number estimation for tabular data as amortized Bayesian inference, using a novel Quantile Feature Encoder to estimate k in a single forward pass and outperforming all competing methods across 50 real-world benchmarks.
